name: KGBuilder nuclear decommissioning bilingual pilot
description: Twenty-four manually annotated, authored/paraphrased German and English examples grounded in the repository's German decommissioning PDFs. English items are paired translations of German facts; variant_of groups translations for split integrity and bootstrap confidence intervals. This is a development pilot, not an independent expert-reviewed held-out benchmark.
